title: I need help with making a menu using parallaxes

posts.author: FylassNolde
posts.body: So! I've been trying to do a custom menu for my game using parallaxes, and I fairly know how to use it thanks to some yt tutorials! The problem is that I dunno the scripts to use so I can open up things like the Equip screen, Formation Screen, Team Screen, etc, so any help with that would be appreciated.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
what do you mean with parallaxes? if you need the scenes,
that depends on the default or customes, for default:
SceneManager.push(Scene_Item)
SceneManager.push(Scene_Equip)
SceneManager.push(Scene_Skill)
SceneManager.push(Scene_Formation)
SceneManager.push(Scene_GameEnd)
SceneManager.push(Scene_GameOver)
as they could be found fairly easy if you can navigate through the
rpg_scenes.js
for custom scenes, it can be called differently.

For some reason, the Formation Scene doesn't work in comparison to the other ones, is there a reason why?

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
Scene_Formation is wrong (my bad) as it connected to Scene_Status.
so I don't know the exact call for getting the formation as it's done
directly on the status scene.
there are formation plugins with custom windows that might work, but
you need to get that scene from the plugin itself.
